attack_queries.condition: one operator splits submissions across identities to exceed the cap
self-generated activity tries to farm points
attack_queries.mitigation: rewardable actions must pass quality gates and duplicate rejection

attack_queries.condition: same proof or watcher range is submitted twice
attack_queries.mitigation: duplicate_key is unique per action family

attack_queries.condition: invalid proof or malformed attestation asks for points
a user tries to redeem XP, levels, or leagues for ZENO or another transferable token
attack_queries.mitigation: XP is a separate non-transferable reputation ledger and never entitles token distribution

attack_queries.condition: a high league attempts to receive a fee rebate, token distribution, yield boost, governance weight, revenue share, or execution priority without the separate tokenomics gate
attack_queries.mitigation: economic benefits require a separate tokenomics manifest, budget gate, abuse controls, and counsel review

attack_queries.condition: XP, levels, leagues, or OG status are used to steer a user toward a specific token, pool, route, venue, LP position, or counterparty
attack_queries.mitigation: benefits must be objective account-status benefits and must pass the covered user interface non-solicitation gate

benefit_programs.description: High-league accounts may qualify for capped protocol-fee discounts after the separate tokenomics and fee-benefit gate is complete.
benefit_programs.eligibility: league >= 4, non-transferable XP threshold met, non-wash activity receipts, eligible identity

benefit_programs.description: High-league accounts may qualify for capped free access to advanced privacy features after the feature-benefit budget gate is complete.
benefit_programs.eligibility: league >= 5, non-transferable XP threshold met, feature-use rate limit, eligible identity

benefit_programs.description: High-league accounts may qualify for capped ZenoCover feature-fee waivers only after the ZenoCover regulatory boundary and benefit budget gates are complete.
benefit_programs.eligibility: league >= 6, non-transferable XP threshold met, ZenoCover jurisdiction and product gate complete, eligible identity
